title: Concept: Ignore file served by the app
description: A version-control ignore file listing build and secret paths in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The file names the paths the team considered sensitive, which is a hint list for anyone probing for leftover configuration and backups.
applicability: Deployments that render a version-control ignore file listing build and secret paths into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The file names the paths the team considered sensitive, which is a hint list for anyone probing for leftover configuration and backups.
